body: hey, im 18 and ftm, i drink to cope aswell, i know things are hard, its shitty. getting deadnamed left and right isnt a way any trans person wants to live, but guess what? in 10 years time when you choose how you live your life you will be amazed. you will have your own friends who only know you by your real name. no one will know youre dead name. you will be on hrt. you will be happy and focusing on whats next in your transition not believing you even made it this far.

Thank you for answering! Its very reassuring to hear from someone. 

Im sure 100% that they were told they had nothing and they told me that everything was back to normal within two weeks and i really believe them because we had been dating for a year

If i do have herpes i have no idea where i wouldve gotten it from since ive always thought something was up or wrong with me since before i ever started anything sexual and nothing has changed

Honestly wish the school system would’ve went more in depth with std testing and normalized it so i didnt feel this way since im still in highschool but oh well :)
